codeReview.summary: Minimal, correct 2-line fix to sdk-native/build.gradle.kts. The cmakeAvailable check now requires feagiFfiIncludeDir.exists() via short-circuit AND before attempting the cmake PATH check. This ensures cmake tasks are only registered when BOTH the FFI include directory exists AND cmake is on PATH. The logic handles all four boolean combinations correctly. The full build passes cleanly: 960 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, 2 skipped.

issues.description: The else-branch log message says 'cmake not found on PATH' but the condition now checks two things (directory existence AND cmake availability). When the real reason for skipping is a missing feagi-java-ffi directory (not cmake), the message is misleading. Consider updating to: 'sdk-native: feagi-java-ffi not found or cmake not on PATH — skipping native JNI build tasks'.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The AGENTS.md says 'The sdk-native build task has a dependsOn(cmakeBuild) hook that will fail without cmake — this must be made conditional'. This is now fully resolved (the hook is conditional on both cmake + FFI dir). AGENTS.md could be updated to note this is done, preventing future workers from re-investigating.
